ddl: CREATE PROCEDURE ORDER_ENTRY.P_ONE AS EXEC(N'SELECT * FROM OPENQUERY(HELIOS_ORACLE, ''SELECT ID, AMOUNT FROM PROCUREMENT.V_ITEMS'');'); EXEC(N'SELECT * FROM OPENQUERY(HELIOS_ORACLE, ''SELECT PROCUREMENT.PROCUREMENT_API.F01() FROM DUAL'');');

name: P_TWO
ddl: CREATE PROCEDURE ORDER_ENTRY.P_TWO AS EXEC(N'SELECT * FROM OPENQUERY(HELIOS_ORACLE, ''SELECT ID, AMOUNT FROM PROCUREMENT.V_ITEMS'');'); EXEC(N'SELECT * FROM OPENQUERY(HELIOS_ORACLE, ''SELECT ID, AMOUNT FROM COMPLIANCE.V_ITEMS'');'); EXEC(N'SELECT * FROM OPENQUERY(HELIOS_ORACLE, ''SELECT PROCUREMENT.PROCUREMENT_API.F01() FROM DUAL'');'); EXEC(N'SELECT * FROM OPENQUERY(HELIOS_ORACLE, ''SELECT COMPLIANCE.COMPLIANCE_API.F01() FROM DUAL'');');

name: P_SCHEMA
ddl: CREATE PROCEDURE ORDER_ENTRY.P_SCHEMA AS EXEC (N'BEGIN PROCUREMENT.P_SCHEMA; END;') AT HELIOS_ORACLE;

name: P_CIRCLE
ddl: CREATE PROCEDURE ORDER_ENTRY.P_CIRCLE AS EXEC (N'BEGIN PROCUREMENT.P_CIRCLE; END;') AT HELIOS_ORACLE;

name: P_CIRCLE
ddl: CREATE PROCEDURE INVENTORY.P_CIRCLE AS EXEC (N'BEGIN COMPLIANCE.P_CIRCLE; END;') AT HELIOS_ORACLE;

name: P_LINK_CHAIN
ddl: CREATE PROCEDURE INVENTORY.P_LINK_CHAIN AS EXEC(N'EXEC ATLAS_SQL.Commerce.ORDER_ENTRY.P_CHAIN;');

name: V_BILLING
ddl: CREATE VIEW ORDER_ENTRY.V_BILLING AS SELECT i.ID, i.AMOUNT FROM Receivables.INVOICING.ITEMS i;

name: RECEIVABLES
ddl: CREATE DATABASE LINK RECEIVABLES CONNECT TO "bridge_user" IDENTIFIED BY "__BENCH_PASSWORD__" USING 'ATLAS_SQL.Receivables';

name: INTELLIGENCE
ddl: CREATE DATABASE LINK INTELLIGENCE CONNECT TO "bridge_user" IDENTIFIED BY "__BENCH_PASSWORD__" USING 'MERIDIAN_SQL.Intelligence';

name: P_RECEIVABLES
ddl: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE PROCUREMENT.P_RECEIVABLES AS N NUMBER; BEGIN EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INVOICING.ITEMS@RECEIVABLES' INTO N; END;

name: P_INTELLIGENCE
ddl: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE COMPLIANCE.P_INTELLIGENCE AS N NUMBER; BEGIN EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORTING.ITEMS@INTELLIGENCE' INTO N; END;

name: P_STOCK
ddl: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE PROCUREMENT.P_STOCK AS N NUMBER; BEGIN EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_ENTRY.V_REMOTE_STOCK@REMOTE' INTO N; END;

name: V_REMOTE_STOCK
ddl: CREATE VIEW ORDER_ENTRY.V_REMOTE_STOCK AS SELECT ID, AMOUNT FROM MERIDIAN_SQL.Distribution.INVENTORY.ITEMS;
